findings.control: agent-watchdog-instruction async-launch gate read only untrusted response text
findings.worst_value: Launch text quoted in a foreground report, output_file /dev/zero

findings.control: Watchdog wake line printed transcript stop_reason and tool names verbatim
findings.worst_value: An injected instruction as stop_reason and as a tool name
findings.fix: Allowlist every printed value; one line

findings.control: Instruction hook path check accepted any absolute path
findings.worst_value: /dev/zero, a key file, a .. traversal, a doubled slash

findings.control: Watchdog blocked forever on a device or FIFO
findings.fix: Read only a regular file; otherwise exit 2

findings.control: Dispatch guard allowed a payload it could not parse
A profile could hide the instruction hook
No test fed a profile the R-708 hooks
Guard allowed a null, missing or lowercased tool_name
Wake-line tool names were shape-allowlisted, not value-allowlisted
findings.fix: Value allowlist; mcp for mcp__, else other

findings.control: Watchdog echoed its path argument verbatim
findings.worst_value: A path with a newline and SYSTEM text
findings.fix: Show only a launch-shaped path, else withheld

findings.control: Guard allowed a padded or non-string tool_name
findings.fix: Non-string reads as empty; whitespace dropped

findings.control: Watchdog shown-path check allowed dot segments and any length
findings.fix: The hook's own check plus a 300-character cap

findings.control: Dispatch guard tool_name normalisation left Unicode padding
findings.worst_value: NBSP, zero-width space, ideographic space, under LC_ALL=C
findings.fix: Reduce the name to its ASCII letters under the C locale before comparing

findings.control: Dispatch guard: a homoglyph made the letter-reduced tool name read as another tool
findings.worst_value: Fullwidth A and Cyrillic A in Agent, under both locales
findings.fix: Ignore only a plain ASCII identifier other than agent or task; judge every other name
